title: Sizeling Origin
description: An origin addon to grant the power of enlarging/reducing!
body:
This Origin Datapack for Fabric or Forge requires the Origins mod and Pehkui Mod

 

The sizeling is a creature with immense control over their own size.


### Starting Small
By nature, you are a small creature. You are 4/5 of the normal player size

### Self Enlargement
By using the latent powers of red mushrooms, you are able to increase your size!

### Bigger Groups
By using more red mushrooms, you not only increase your own size, but those around you too!

### Self Reduction
By using the latent powers of brown mushrooms, you are able to reduce your size!
  
### Smaller Groups
By using more brown mushrooms, you not only reduce your own size, but those around you too

### Return to Form
By channeling the powers of the nether-realm from Nether Warts, you can reset your size

### Growth Spurts
You seem to have a growth-spurt whenever you sleep…



If you'd like to support me, the continued updating of this resourcepack, and other projects, I have a [patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Shasskor)! The cheapest tier lets you ask for a custom minecraft skin texture and I'll put it in a resource pack for you!
